recap.paragraph: In Mexico City, the 49ers had a shot at a 9-1 record. Brock Purdy zipped a 17-yard touchdown pass to George Kittle. Aaron Jones Sr. ran for a Vikings touchdown. Then the 49ers surged for 21 points in the second quarter. Purdy hit Mike Evans for a score, and Ji'Ayir Brown raced back a pick-six! Christian McCaffrey ran in another touchdown as San Francisco won 35-10. The 49ers reached 9-1, while the Vikings fell to 7-3.
